items.name: Seven Sisters High (Ch. 1)
items.legend: Clocks (10 total) • Key in 1F Janitor's Room • Boss on 4F Roof
items.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 600 220" class="map-svg" role="img" aria-label="Seven Sisters High Schematic">
          <rect x="20" y="30" width="120" height="150" fill="none" stroke="var(--line)" stroke-width="2"/>
          <text x="30" y="50" fill="var(--muted)" font-size="11" font-family="IBM Plex Mono">1F COURTYARD & HALL</text>
          <rect x="160" y="30" width="130" height="150" fill="none" stroke="var(--line)" stroke-width="2"/>
          <text x="170" y="50" fill="var(--muted)" font-size="11" font-family="IBM Plex Mono">2F CLASS 2-B / LOUNGE</text>
          <rect x="310" y="30" width="130" height="150" fill="none" stroke="var(--line)" stroke-width="2"/>
          <text x="320" y="50" fill="var(--muted)" font-size="11" font-family="IBM Plex Mono">3F PRINCIPAL OFFICE</text>
          <rect x="460" y="30" width="120" height="150" fill="none" stroke="var(--line)" stroke-width="2"/>
          <text x="470" y="50" fill="var(--muted)" font-size="11" font-family="IBM Plex Mono">4F CLOCK TOWER</text>
          <g class="map-marker" data-step="ch01-s005"><circle cx="80" cy="110" r="8" fill="var(--warn)"/><text x="80" y="135" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--text)" font-size="10">3 Clocks + Janitor Key</text></g>
          <g class="map-marker" data-step="ch01-s005"><circle cx="225" cy="110" r="8" fill="var(--tip)"/><text x="225" y="135" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--text)" font-size="10">Hanako + 5 Clocks</text></g>

          <g class="map-marker" data-step="ch01-s006"><circle cx="520" cy="110" r="8" fill="var(--accent)"/><text x="520" y="135" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--text)" font-size="10">Boss: Hanya</text></g>
        </svg>

items.name: Mt. Iwato — 4 Missable Masks (Ch. 3)
items.legend: Collect all 4 Masks BEFORE entering B4F Final Reflecting Pool

          <rect x="20" y="25" width="260" height="165" fill="none" stroke="var(--line)" stroke-width="2"/>
          <text x="30" y="45" fill="var(--muted)" font-size="11" font-family="IBM Plex Mono">B1F REFLECTING POOLS</text>
          <rect x="300" y="25" width="140" height="165" fill="none" stroke="var(--line)" stroke-width="2"/>
          <text x="310" y="45" fill="var(--muted)" font-size="11" font-family="IBM Plex Mono">B2F PITFALL ROOM</text>
          <rect x="460" y="25" width="120" height="165" fill="none" stroke="var(--line)" stroke-width="2"/>
          <text x="470" y="45" fill="var(--muted)" font-size="11" font-family="IBM Plex Mono">B3F -> B4F POOL</text>
          <g class="map-marker" data-step="ch03-s005"><circle cx="80" cy="95" r="8" fill="#e879f9"/><text x="80" y="118" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--text)" font-size="10">Pink Azas (E of 1st)</text></g>

          <g class="map-marker" data-step="ch03-s005"><circle cx="370" cy="115" r="8" fill="#60a5fa"/><text x="370" y="138" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--text)" font-size="10">Blue Swan (S of Pool)</text></g>
          <g class="map-marker" data-step="ch03-s006"><circle cx="520" cy="115" r="8" fill="var(--accent)"/><text x="520" y="138" text-anchor="middle" fill="var(--text)" font-size="10">Point of No Return</text></g>
        </svg>
